catches: Existing member earns $50 for each new member who opens an active checking account or qualifying loan.
Maximum $500 per year in referral rewards.
New member receives $50 with a new active checking account or a qualifying loan.
Checking is active with 5+ qualifying transactions per monthly statement cycle (debit card, direct deposit, Bill Pay, automatic withdrawal, check, or cash deposit; <$5 transactions don't count).
Excludes home mortgages and savings accounts; eligible on all consumer checking accounts and consumer loans.
Referral must be eligible for membership; existing member must be in good standing and fill out the Referral Form online.
Must be 18 or older; employees are not eligible.
Reward deposited into each member's savings account within 60 days of meeting the qualifications.
Member is responsible for any related taxes per MN law.
Offer effective 1/1/26 - 12/31/26 and subject to change without notice.
